description:
We’ve configured the repository to allow users to open a completely blank issue if they prefer, so you can start a discussion without any pre‑filled template.

If you need to get in touch for specific purposes, two dedicated channels are available. For any security‑related concerns, please submit a private report at https://github.com/example/repo/security – this lets us address vulnerabilities safely and promptly. For ideas and enhancements, head over to our discussions page at https://github.com/example/repo/discussions/new?category=ideas, where you can propose new features or suggest improvements to the project.
